reporting-org.narrative: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre

title.narrative: Supporting the Turkish Ministry of Health with 20 fully equipped ambulances

description.narrative: Providing ambulance services and ambulance transportation, and strengthening the field ambulance and medical referral system by adding 20 ambulances.

Raising the readiness of ambulance services and the ambulance transport system by supporting the ambulance transport fleet and covering the geographical scope by transporting patients and injured people to and from hospitals and contributing to saving their lives, rapid intervention and reducing deaths in all beneficiary areas.
Supporting the ambulance system in Turkey with 20 ambulances, strengthening the field ambulance and medical referral system, and raising the readiness of ambulance services.
